title: 1988 SAIC anti-gravity study for Edwards Air Force Base

tellings.quote: 1988, the corporation SAIC was tasked with studying electric propulsion and anti-gravity for Edwards Air Force Base.

plain: In 1988 SAIC, a large defense contracting company, was hired to study electric propulsion and anti-gravity for Edwards Air Force Base in California. Michels tells this himself, citing the study and naming the physicist James Woodward and a researcher named Ferris Williams in connection with it. If it is true, the Air Force was paying for anti-gravity research in the late 1980s.
